title: Thanksgiving Baked Mac and Cheese
summary: Ultra-creamy five-cheese mac with a spiced béchamel and a broiled, golden cheesy top.
difficulty_reason: A béchamel and a heat-sensitive cheese sauce need attention so it stays smooth, not grainy.

ingredients.line: 3 to 4 cups whole milk, as needed
2 lb pasta of choice (such as cavatappi or macaroni)

steps: Shred all the cheeses and mix them into one blend; save a handful for the top. Heat the broiler later; for now, start boiling salted water for the pasta.
Melt the butter in a large Dutch oven over medium heat, then stir in the garlic powder, smoked paprika, cayenne and ginger for about a minute to bloom them.
Whisk in the flour and cook for a couple of minutes.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking constantly, until you have a smooth béchamel. Keep it a little thinner than you think you need, since the cheese will thicken it.
Stir in the Dijon and heavy cream. Cook the pasta in the meantime, 1 to 2 minutes short of the package time.
Turn off the heat so the sauce can't split. Melt in the American cheese, then add the cheese blend in small handfuls, stirring until smooth.
Taste and season generously with salt and pepper.
Fold the drained pasta into the sauce and pour it into an oven-safe baking dish.
Top with the reserved cheese and broil for a couple of minutes until bubbling and golden.
Garnish with chives and serve hot.
tips: Turn the heat off before adding cheese; a too-hot sauce splits and turns grainy.
Make the béchamel a little thin, because the cheese thickens it a lot.
The American cheese is for its emulsifiers and keeps the sauce silky without adding flavor.
